title: Arithmetic Stein-degree bounds for log Calabi–Yau pairs

abstractEnglish: Fix d ≥ 1 and t > 0. Let $`(X,B)`$ be an ordinary projective log canonical ℚ-pair of dimension d over a characteristic-zero field k, with X normal and integral, $`H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)=k`$, B effective, and $`K_X+B\sim_{\mathbb Q}0`$. We prove that every prime component S of B with coefficient at least t satisfies $`[k_S:k]\leq N(d,t)`$, where kS is the relative algebraic closure of k in $`k(S)`$. This also bounds the Stein degree of S over k, proving the contraction-to-a-point formulation of Birkar's Stein-degree conjecture for ordinary ℚ-pairs.
titleEn: Arithmetic Stein-degree bounds for log Calabi–Yau pairs

details.overview: 该稿件研究特征零域上普通射影对数典范ℚ对(X,B)的算术性质。作者声称证明了对于维数d和系数下界t>0，B中系数至少为t的每个素分支S满足[k_S:k]≤N(d,t)，其中k_S是k在k(S)中的相对代数闭包。该结果也界定了S在k上的Stein度，从而证明Birkar Stein度猜想在普通ℚ对上的收缩到点表述。研究意义在于为对数Calabi–Yau对提供了统一的算术度界。
